metadata.title: RVR.workgroupDSCtooling
metadata.description:
This module provides  DSC resources and tools used to configure a Windows Workgroup computer
(that is a non domain joined host).

DSC resources:
- SetDNSSuffix
  Use this resource to configure the DNSSuffix of the computer. This is a prerequisite for installing Exchange server.
